truth: Canonical main is 4400654e7cdee8830b4bf2d9d4d75d017baba189 after merged PR #49 landed SONG-01A. Hosted execution for prior UX/SONG increments remains UNOBSERVED unless explicitly observed otherwise.

SONG-01A is landed: /song exposes canonical work Session objective, durable open-session Quit/relaunch, explicit debrief plus next action, and meaningful second relaunch without automatic evidence promotion.
UX-01 remains ACTIVE for later retained quality/outcome work; SONG-01 remains ACTIVE for the remaining Song-start/resume/creative-context requirements.

Global reselection chose SONG-01B on exact baseline 4400654e7cdee8830b4bf2d9d4d75d017baba189 because REQ-SCOPE-060 still requires observations, decisions, rejected ideas, unresolved ear decisions and MARKs while CORE-02A already supplies their complete append-only canonical write model.

SONG-01B was selected instead of version/asset resume UI because that current candidate is primarily a read/inspection surface, instead of suggestion/template/randomize because persisted catalog/distance/lock/suppression/generator product state does not yet exist, and instead of DAW-00/OPS-04 because this required Song customer gap is fully construction-ready and directly advances actual creative continuity.

Canonical SessionMemory supports exactly OBSERVATION, DECISION, REJECTED_IDEA, UNRESOLVED and MARK; append_scratch is open-Session-only and append-only; items_for_session is chronological; Activity receipts are already canonical.

SessionMemory also has explicit promotion machinery, but SONG-01B does not expose it because the product lacks an accepted artist-facing semantic-key contract. Raw evidence keys must not leak into the creative notebook and scratch must not silently become Song doctrine.
Session capture remains canonical Session history, not browser state, global Artist doctrine, Headquarters Focus or DAW FocusContext.
All capture actions must derive authority from the exact active Song/open Session plus server-bound one-shot actions; client-submitted raw Session IDs or arbitrary kinds are not trusted.
Capturing notes must not mutate DAWs, create audio, connect providers, create operations, change Song/version/assets or implicitly publish evidence claims.

TemplateDefinition/TemplatePlanner and RecipeDefinition/RecipePlanner are real provider-neutral planning substrate, but they do not yet provide persisted template catalogs, consumer suggestion distance/locks/suppression or deterministic AI-off creative generation; those remain later bounded product-model work.

SongResumeService provides truthful current/approved version, recent changes, evidence conflicts and explicit evidence-based next action, but exposing that read model does not outrank the ready in-session capture gap for this selection.
Authored proof remains distinct from executed proof. Local GitHub resolution remains unavailable in this runtime; empty hosted workflow/status surfaces are UNOBSERVED rather than green or failed.
